reviewNotes: Twenty-five object strings covering energizing food, supply crates, forage meals, rare fruit and flowers, taro, tea products, camping gear, a combat ring, and a mineral were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover established glossary names, crop timing and water-adjacent growth, tea production, one-use camping behavior, combat effects, object gender, mystery punctuation, and technical preservation; both found no remaining objective issue.

SupplyCrate_Description.preservationReason: The ellipsis is the complete player-facing mystery description and must remain unchanged.

SurvivalBurger_Description.source: A convenient snack for the explorer.

SweetGemBerry_Description.source: It's by far the sweetest thing you've ever smelled.
SweetGemBerry_Description.translation: Este de departe cel mai dulce lucru pe care l-ai mirosit vreodată.

TaroRoot_Description.source: This starchy root is one of the most ancient crops.
TaroRoot_Description.translation: Această rădăcină bogată în amidon este una dintre cele mai vechi culturi agricole.

TaroTuber_Description.source: Plant these in warm weather. Takes 10 days to mature. Grows faster if planted near a body of water.
TaroTuber_Description.translation: Plantează-i pe vreme caldă. Ajung la maturitate în 10 zile. Cresc mai repede dacă sunt plantați lângă o întindere de apă.

TeaLeaves_Description.source: The young leaves of the tea plant. Can be brewed into the popular, energizing beverage.
TeaLeaves_Description.translation: Frunzele tinere ale plantei de ceai. Din ele se poate prepara băutura populară și energizantă.

TeaSapling_Description.source: Takes 20 days to mature. Produces tea leaves during the final week of each season, except winter. No watering necessary!
TeaSapling_Description.translation: Ajunge la maturitate în 20 de zile. Produce frunze de ceai în ultima săptămână a fiecărui anotimp, cu excepția iernii. Nu necesită udare!

TentKit_Description.source: Use this to deploy a one-time-use tent for sleeping. Can only be used outdoors.
TentKit_Description.translation: Folosește-l pentru a monta un cort de unică folosință în care să dormi. Poate fi folosit doar în aer liber.

ThornsRing_Description.source: When enemies damage you, they will take damage themselves.
ThornsRing_Description.translation: Când inamicii îți provoacă daune, suferă și ei daune.
